title: Felt Letters
description: A felt piano traces an aching chord progression over a swung LinnDrum breakbeat, ghost hats whispering underneath. It rises to a warm peak, falls into a hushed reverb-soaked valley, then climbs again before drifting out on delay and air.
code:
setcpm(128/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3] [bb2,d3,f3] [g2,bb2,d3]>/2").s("piano").room(0.55).gain(0.6).lpf(1400),
    s("hh*8").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.32).degradeBy(0.4).pan(sine.range(0.35,0.65)).cut(1)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd ~]").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.95).swingBy(0.16, 4),
